title: Thai Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and gluten-free wrap filled with spicy Thai chicken and crunchy vegetables. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: 1. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
3. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
4. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and the Thai red curry paste.
5. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the curry paste is fragrant.
6. Pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine.
7. Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the curry sauce.
8. Warm the gluten-free wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
9. Assemble the wrap by placing the chicken mixture onto the center of the wrap, followed by the lettuce, cucumber, carrots, and cilantro (if using).
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
